page.layout: One photograph of a book spine, with a digitiser's credit block below it. No printed page text.
page.notes: The scan shows a leather-bound spine with gold tooling, not a printed page. The gilt title on the red label is only partly legible and cannot be read reliably. It seems to contain the words "...MEDICAE", but I cannot confirm the rest. The lines "Early European Books, Copyright © 2012 ProQuest LLC. Images reproduced by courtesy of The Wellcome Trust, London. 3439/A" are the digitiser's banner and are excluded.
